feeds.title: Seán Crossan's Scots Law
feeds.description: Seán Crossan's Scots Law a companion blog to Introductory Scots Law (3rd Edition) finds articles such as 'The Queen's Speech', 'Revolutionary Road?', and many more to improve your knowledge about Scottish Law.

feeds.title: The Time Blawg
feeds.description: Brian Inkster is a Lawyer with an active interest in entrepreneurship, marketing, and technology in relation to running a law firm. Through The Time Blawg Brian expresses his views on the past, present, and future practice of law.

feeds.title: JustRight Scotland Blog
feeds.description: JustRight Scotland provides you with information and helps you understand current legal facts and their impact on society. We keep you informed. Read about our latest news, our blog posts, and our press releases.

feeds.title: Edinburgh Private Law Blog
feeds.description: The Edinburgh Private Law Blog provides expert insight and debate on a range of fields related to Private Law. The Blog is a home for many different methodological approaches to the study of Private Law. Posts are based on research taking place at Edinburgh Law School and other academic Institutions.

feeds.title: Edinburgh University Press Blog » Scots Law
feeds.description: The Edinburgh University Press Blogs brings you original articles, thought pieces, and sneak peeks into journals and books, as well as commentary and interviews with our authors and editors.

feeds.title: HeraldScotland » Law
feeds.description: The Herald & Times Group is one of Scotland's most successful and established media companies. Our newspaper division publishes The Herald, Evening Times, Sunday Herald, and The National as well as a portfolio of successful Regional titles. Get the latest law news on the Herald Scotland to stay updated with all the information related to it.

feeds.title: The Scottish charity and wealth law blog
feeds.description: The Scottish charity and wealth law will give you blog posts where they are covering various Law related articles and information related to it.

feeds.title: The Scottish Lawyer Blog
feeds.description: The aim of the Scottish Lawyer is to increase access to the legal profession for anyone who aspires to be a part of it, no matter their background. My hope is that by sharing my experiences and that of others, whilst adding some helpful resources and templates for you to use it will make your route in the law less daunting than what I remember it to be for me.

feeds.title: ScotsLawBlog
feeds.description: Scots Law Blog is a blog otherwise known as'blawg', showcasing and contributing to scots law. It is designed for law firms, lawyers, and law students to display their own legal knowledge and skills, to help educate law students and others on Scots Law, and to help connect businesses and consumers with valuable legal information and connect them with the best Scottish Lawyer for them.

feeds.title: My Scottish Law Blog
feeds.description: Solicitors are cautious folk and hate putting pen to paper about opinions rather than solid legal issues. Explore my blogs to read some very informative articles concerning the law of Scotland and your rights there.

feeds.title: Scottish Family Law Blog
feeds.description: Scottish Family Law was launched to assist clients to agree on matters relating to their finance and to obtain divorces quickly and efficiently.

feeds.title: Thomas Leonard Ross KC
feeds.description: Thomas Leonard Ross QC is a blog page where you will find articles like 'Should Scottish Judges Have the Power to Order Whole Life Tariffs'?, 'EncroChat - the Court of Appeal Judgment', 'Legal Challenges to the EncroChat Hack - an Introduction', and many more.
